verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party published benchmarks or measured latency/throughput figures from Ghostty. The only numbers come from community comments citing external third-party benchmarks (an older one ranking Ghostty worst on input latency, a newer one averaging ~13ms) plus anecdotal throughput impressions. Those are not the product's own published performance data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/throughput numbers backing the terminal's performance claims
